Synonyms are not an engine feature; they are a *pre-engine* transform. QueryPipeline's

, which is precisely why a single synonym row reaches both Postgres Search and the Indx Engine without either engine knowing it happened. Postgres then matches the expanded terms against its Search Vector; Indx feeds them into BM25F.

Putting expansion upstream keeps the two engines behind one honest Search contract: corrections, aliases, and learned fixes are applied in exactly one place, so the engines never drift in how they interpret a query. The downstream effect of synonym expansion on relevance is one of the levers the Golden Eval harness measures.
